plugins.name: claude-md-plugin
plugins.description: Node-agent tree plugin (v19). Each directory is an agent: its CLAUDE.md is the agent's prompt, its source code is the agent's tool set, and cohesive sub-domains become child agents to whom the parent delegates. v19 is an in-progress redesign; v18 workflows are pending teardown.

plugins.name: project-init
plugins.description: Multi-language project setup plugin. Sets up code conventions, dependencies, CLAUDE.md, and installs a language-specific convention skill into the target project.

plugins.name: flow
plugins.description: DAG-based task execution engine. Turns a user request into atomic subtasks, builds a DAG with deterministic per-node validators, executes independent nodes in parallel via git-worktree-isolated agents, and performs merge+validate as an independent cascade step (git-conflict → project tests → LLM semantic review). Persistent state under .claude/workflows/flow/{task-id}/ enables resume.
